_what: What the re-extraction at contract 180.4.0 moved in the metric corpus: the hints of all 586 served metrics read 2026-11-19 20:36 - 20:50Z over one mcporter runtime (scripts/refresh_metric_contracts.py, EXTRACTION_STAMP=20261119b, EXTRACTION_TRANSPORT=runtime; a first read under stamp 20261119 stopped at 160 of 586 on a local socket error, WinError 10055, and nothing of it is in the corpus; the 171.0.0 batches archived as archive_20261112c_extraction), against the committed 171.0.0 records (v0.14.3, 8cb0e02). ATH is undocumented (by 177, the 177 drift record); DAY_HIGH, DAY_LOW, WEEK_HIGH and WEEK_LOW are contract 180.4.0's (battlegrid-manager docs/status/2026-11-18-contract-180-4.md). Every move below is read from the served hints.

operandLists.ATH: a plain spread operand of all 413 price bases (spreadOperands AND spreadOperandsOffAnchor), an averaged operand (spreadAverageOperands, ...OffAnchor) of the same 413, and an operand of the chained outers (spread 384 inner entries; trajectory / efficiency 108; aggregate, cci, ema, linregSlope, pctl, rma, roc, rollingMax, rollingMin, rsi, stddev, wma, zscore 96 each), on and off the anchor rung
operandLists.DAY_HIGH, DAY_LOW, WEEK_HIGH, WEEK_LOW: a plain spread operand of the 413 price bases ON the anchor rung only (spreadOperands; absent from spreadOperandsOffAnchor and from every averaged list) and an operand of the 384 chained spread outers' `operands` (not operandsOffAnchor) - the shape of a per-bar session-profile level
operandLists.CLOSE, LAST: still in every price base's operand lists at 180.4.0: contract v181 (announced, not served) drops them; omega refuses the form already (omega.contract.price_operand_refused)
